purpose: Neutral account/environment and encrypted test-result transport only; no change to frozen business cases/assertions/HTTP timing methods
wire: UTF-8 JSON with exactly protected,encrypted_key_b64,nonce_b64,ciphertext_and_tag_b64; strict duplicate-key rejection
aad: ASCII bytes of JSON(protected,ensure_ascii=True,sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False); comma/colon separators have no spaces
key_wrap: Fresh random32-byte AES key; RSA>=3072bit certificate recipient; OAEP hashSHA256; MGF1SHA256; label=None
aes: AES256GCM; fresh random12-byte nonce; ciphertext_and_tag_b64 contains ciphertext immediately followed by16-byte tag; AAD is protected canonical JSON
base64: Standard RFC4648 alphabet, padded, no line breaks; strict validation
recipient_cert_sha256: Lowercase hex SHA256 of the X509 certificate DER bytes, NOT PEM file bytes
downgrade_policy: Reject changed/unknown format,algorithm,recipient,purpose,field sets or invalid lengths; authenticate before using plaintext; do not bypass TLS verification or fall back to unauthenticated encryption

calibration.scope: Known-data producer/independent-receiver, independent-producer/receiver, wrapped-key/nonce/ciphertext/protected-header tampering and canonical roundtrip; no SUT

remote_crypto_runtime_status: NOT_VERIFIED; independently freeze actual load-host crypto runtime before use
